key_idea: Each time the side gets 1 longer, the path needs 4 more stones.
steps: Count the stones in the pictures: side 1 needs 8, side 2 needs 12 and side 3 needs 16.
Each time the side gets 1 longer, there is 1 more stone on each of the 4 sides, so 4 more stones.

choice_feedback.A: 20 stones is for side 4. Side 5 needs 4 more.
choice_feedback.C: The number goes up by 4 each time: 16, 20, 24. It never stops on 22.
choice_feedback.D: 28 stones would be for side 6, which is too big.
choice_feedback.E: 32 stones would be for side 7, which is too big.
